product_wide_rationale: Governs how every worker lane starts and how its authorization binds, across all Domains that dispatch work. It sets an execution boundary rather than owning a runtime Domain.
summary: Typed dispatch authorizes one attempt and queues its native Task after host permission, without another model-authored launch or a worker model override. The queue preserves the parent's host-selected model and variant. Managed Tasks consume one authorized packet window; utilities do not consume it. Ordinary unmanaged Tasks retain host permissions and create no Concord evidence. Completion reads the host child, derives report identity, and settles terminal events through the retained call identity. Lanes do not own workflow state.
title: Run lane dispatch as a native Task under a one-time authorization
